name: _progress-bar.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/_progress-bar.scss — the top route-progress bar: scaleX sweep on
//  navigation start, fast completion + fade on route resolve
//  (nprogress-style, never visibly retracts).
//  Imported by app.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Progress bar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.progress-bar {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: to-rem(2);
  width: 100%;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  background: var(--grey);
  z-index: 9999;
  transition:
    transform 0.1s ease,
    opacity 0.3s ease;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;

  &--active {
    transform: scaleX(0.7);
    opacity: 1;
    transition: transform 8s cubic-bezier(0.04, 0.6, 0.2, 1);
  }

  // Route finished: sweep to 100% quickly, then fade out in place — the
  // later class removal snaps scaleX back to 0 while opacity is already
  // 0, so the bar never visibly retracts (nprogress-style completion).
  &--done {
    transform: scaleX(1);
    opacity: 0;
    transition:
      transform 0.3s ease-out,
      opacity 0.4s ease 0.3s;
  }
}
